title: 第2章：以物换物
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【检测到宿主回收了一个坏掉的苹果。宿主可选择使用一积分，用坏苹果换好苹果，也可以直接兑换两积分。】

苹果可以回收，还能以物换物，这系统真不错！

苏安安眼眸一亮，毫不犹豫地选择换苹果。

下一刻，机械的系统提示音，再次传入耳里。

【宿主积分不足，兑换失败。】

听见系统的声音，苏安安小脸一垮。

想兑换新鲜苹果，还得收回其他东西换积分。

可她的身上什么都没有，连衣裳都被扒了，还有什么能回收的呢？

想着，苏安安转头看向四周，想寻找能回收的物品。

可看了一圈，她目光所及之处，除了稻草就只有几块破砖头。

她随手抓了一把稻草在手里，“统统，这个能回收吗？”

【恭喜宿主成功回收一把稻草，获得2积分。】

稻草能回收，那砖头是不是也可以回收？

苏安安圆溜溜的眼眸一亮，伸手摸向身边的砖头。

与刚才一样，她的小手刚触碰到砖头，砖头便消失了。

【恭喜宿主成功回收砖头，获得2积分。】

【提醒，砖头、稻草一类的无价值物品，每天只能收回一次。】

苏安安刚想抓系统的bug，多回收一些树枝，就被系统发现了。

她尴尬一笑，松开了手里的砖头。

“统统，我要换苹果。”

随着她的声音落下，一颗新鲜的苹果，便出现在了她的小手中。

她拿起苹果咬了一小口。

苹果脆脆的、甜甜的，是熟悉的味道。

她张开嘴，想要咬第二口。

小米牙还没落下，便又忍住了。

她不能再吃了，娘亲还饿着肚子呢，她得把苹果留给娘亲吃。

咕噜……

可是她还是好饿呀！

苏安安靠着佛像，捂着自己的肚子。

“统统，有没有其他吃的呀？”

【积分商城有食物。馒头10积分，包子20积分，牛奶20积分……】

系统一一给苏安安介绍商城里的食物，听得苏安安越来越饿。

“这是什么破地方？”

身后，传来苏晚吟的声音。

苏安安慢慢爬起来，趴在佛像背后，探着小脑袋往外看。

只见武官领着永宁侯府的人，快步走进来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

[It is detected that the host has recycled a broken apple.The host can choose to use one point to exchange bad apples for good apples, or they can directly redeem two points.】

Apples can be recycled and exchanged for things. What a great system!

Su Anan's eyes lit up and she chose to switch to apples without hesitation.

The next moment, the mechanical system prompts reached my ears again.

[Insufficient host points, redemption failed.】

Hearing the sound of the system, Su Anan's face fell.

If you want to exchange for fresh apples, you have to take back other items in exchange for points.

But there was nothing on her body, even her clothes were taken off, what else could be recycled?

Thinking about it, Su Anan turned around and looked around, looking for items that could be recycled.

But after looking around, as far as she could see, there were only a few broken bricks besides straw.

She casually grabbed a handful of straw in her hand and said, "Tong, can this be recycled?"

[Congratulations to the host for successfully recovering a handful of straw and earning 2 points.】

Straw can be recycled, but can bricks also be recycled?

Su Anan's round eyes lit up and she reached out to touch the bricks beside her.

Just like before, as soon as her little hand touched the brick, the brick disappeared.

[Congratulations to the host for successfully recovering the bricks and earning 2 points.】

[Reminder, worthless items such as bricks and straw can only be recovered once a day.】

Just as Su Anan wanted to catch the system bug and recycle more branches, the system discovered it.

She smiled awkwardly and let go of the brick in her hand.

"Everything, I want to trade for apples."

As her voice fell, a fresh apple appeared in her little hand.

She picked up the apple and took a small bite.

Apples are crunchy, sweet, and have a familiar taste.

She opened her mouth for a second bite.

Before Xiaomi's teeth fell, he held back again.

She couldn't eat anymore, her mother was still hungry, so she had to leave the apple to her mother.

Gulu...

But she is still so hungry!

Su Anan leaned against the Buddha statue and held her stomach.

"Tongtong, is there anything else to eat?"

[There is food in the Points Mall.10 points for steamed buns, 20 points for steamed buns, 20 points for milk...]

The system introduced the food in the mall to Su An'an one by one, and Su An'an became more and more hungry.

"What kind of crappy place is this?"

Su Wanyin's voice came from behind.

Su Anan slowly got up, lay down behind the Buddha statue, and looked out with her little head.

I saw the military attaché leading the people from the Yongning Hou Mansion and walking in quickly.
